hardware_notes: Use a smooth precision 5 mm running section through each 625ZZ inner race, with M5 threads outside the races or a custom axle.
Modeled M5 heads are low-profile 8.5 mm diameter x 3.5 mm high. Verify supplied screw head envelopes.
Nominal 6 mm shoulder bolts do not fit 5 mm-bore 625ZZ bearings.
manufacturing_notes: Individual STEP and STL files share the contact-pose assembly placement. Arrange STL orientations for manufacture.

clearance_intervals.message: No intersections at 41 checked poses; Ø44 projected optical field clear of printed parts.

verification.description: No intersections at 41 checked poses; Ø44 projected optical field clear of printed parts. Sampled BRep checks do not establish continuous clearance or structural stiffness. Tangent contact is allowed.

printed_optical_exclusion.scope: Continuous printed-part optical exclusion for the prescribed vertical motion. Physical drive collisions are checked separately with an all-pairs BRep pose audit. The optical corridor is a conservative projected housing footprint, not a measured lens field of view.
